goal: P11 publish, invalidate and revert in backend/services/research_factory/ and backend/routers/.
summary: Completed production implementation of Phase P11 release management in the AI Research Factory. Built two-phase preflight validation against publication gates, immutable snapshot creation with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signed revisions, atomic database publication pointer swap, comprehensive object & media cache purging, granular invalidation/retraction of expired sources or disputed claims, and emergency atomic rollback capabilities. Fully verified CONC-009 negative abuse protection: catastrophic mid-release failures cleanly abort the transaction, guaranteeing zero half-published stories or dangling unlinked objects.

endpoints_implemented.description: Two-phase preflight gate check across editorial approval, claim corroboration, rights clearance, and 2D rubbing fallbacks.
Atomic creation of frozen snapshot, HMAC-SHA256 signed revision, story status swap, and cache purging.
Lookup currently active published release for a given content scope.
Fetch release manifest, signed revision, and full snapshot payload.
P11 watcher invalidation protocol for rights expiration, scholarly disputes, or 404 broken links.
Atomically revert publication release to prior approved version or demote to internal review, invalidating CDN caches.
Audited ledger of correction events and cache purge records.

invariants_verified.preflight_gates: Enforces strict validation before publication: blocks unreviewed 'draft' stories, blocks disputed claims ('disputed', 'needs_source'), blocks revoked sources (rights_status='revoked'), and ensures all 3D assets have verified 2D rubbing fallbacks.
invariants_verified.atomic_snapshot_and_signing: Frozen immutable snapshot payload computed with canonical JSON serialization and SHA-256 manifest digest. Signed revision bound to manifest_sha256, release_code, and signer identity using HMAC-SHA256 constant-time verification.
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_conc009: Failure mid-release cannot show half-published stories or dangling unlinked objects. Simulated or unexpected exceptions during the release transaction immediately revert all story mutations and discard the uncommitted release; unauthenticated requests return 404.
invariants_verified.tamper_detection: Modifying any byte of the manifest SHA, release code, or signer identity causes constant-time signature verification to fail deterministically.
invariants_verified.invalidation_retraction: P11 invalidation immediately demotes stories to 'archived', claims to 'disputed', and marks revoked sources; registers append-only ResearchCorrectionEvent and purges CDN caches.
invariants_verified.atomic_rollback: Emergency rollback marks release as ROLLED_BACK, restores previous version's snapshot if provided, purges stale caches, and prevents duplicate rollback attempts with HTTP 409 Conflict.
invariants_verified.cache_purge_engine: Registers ResearchCachePurgeEvent for story slugs, entity keys, and core listing routes, alongside AssetCacheRevocation entries for immediate CDN and proxy purging.
invariants_verified.role_based_access_control: Requires staff or admin permissions; learners and unauthenticated callers receive 403 Forbidden and 401 Unauthorized.
